lane: T12 — Visual fix round 1: tab labels, phone-width hero, board row density (both panels + static views)
source: the app's own 390 x 900 renders of the pre-fix trees (./before), plus the design contract §7

findings.observed: BEFORE: the strip wrapped to two rows in BOTH panels. Workbench: `Overview | Questions | Workmate` + a lone `s` + `Memory` on row 2 (the 9-character label broke MID-WORD). Team: `Board | Members | Detail` + `Watchdog` on row 2.
findings.why: the app lays the tab strip out at content width and wraps a label rather than scrolling it, so four labels must fit ONE line at 390 px.
findings.fix: English labels shortened to <= 8 characters each and <= 24 per strip: Workbench `Overview | Ask | Agents | Memory` (23), Team `Board | Members | Detail | Watch` (23). The Chinese labels already fit (2+2+4+2 / 2+2+2+3) and are unchanged.
findings.test: “every tab label fits ONE line at a 390 px viewport (repair T12)” — 4 labels, each <= 8 chars, strip <= 24, in BOTH languages and BOTH panels

findings.observed: BEFORE: each hero laid its metric grid out ONE CELL PER ROW at 390 px (the app's own grid degradation), so four tiles plus the completion bar made the hero ~500 px tall and pushed the board entirely below the fold. `Tasks` and `Blocked` additionally rendered as `—` because the preview data lacked those paths.
findings.why: the grid's `columns: 2` is honoured only while every cell keeps its minimum width; at phone width the app falls back to one column, and the hero's height is then linear in the tile count.
findings.fix: each hero now carries TWO tiles — the actionable numbers — and the rest moved to the caption / progress bar: Workbench `Ready | Active` + completion (caption keeps `N Ready · N Active · N Members`); Team `Active | Done` + completion (caption now `name · N Tasks · N Blocked`).
findings.test: “each hero carries at most TWO metric tiles (the phone grid is one cell per row)”
findings.measured: mpd-v2 3999 B -> 3831 B, 50 -> 48 nodes; mpd-team-v2 4600 B -> 4389 B, 57 -> 55 nodes (each tile is 2 nodes: the metric and its wrapper cell)

findings.observed: BEFORE: a board row read `T1 Adapt the view …` with `in_progress` in the trailing column and `Deep Worker · work` under it. The 11-character machine status plus the chevron took enough width that the subject clipped after ~13 characters, and the kind line repeated what the Detail tab already shows.
findings.why: the trailing column and the title share one row; every character the status spends is a character the subject loses.
findings.fix: the status is spelled short (`in_progress` -> `active`, `completed`/`done` -> `done`, `pending` -> `todo`, anything else clipped to 8) and the subtitle is owner-only plus `blocked N` when a row is blocked — the kind moved to the Detail tab.
findings.test: “board rows are DENSE: a short trailing word and an owner-only subtitle (repair T12)”

The two `—` tiles in the BEFORE image came from the PREVIEW DATA (`.mpd/recon/render-data.json` lacks `counts.total` / `counts.blocked`), not from the panel: the live push model carries both. The fix removes those two tiles from the hero anyway, so the ambiguity is gone from the default view.
